key_insight: A least-squares weak Galerkin formulation solves linear elasticity on general polytopal meshes with a symmetric positive definite system and locking-free behavior near incompressibility.
engineering_relevance: This makes elasticity simulation more robust for complex geometries and challenging boundary or interface conditions without relying on a discrete inf-sup condition.
method: Uses weak differential operators: weak gradient, weak strain tensor, and weak divergence.
Builds a least-squares weak Galerkin finite element scheme on polygonal/polyhedral meshes.
Proves uniqueness and optimal-order error estimates in a discrete energy norm.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive numerical experiments showing the method matches the theory and performs stably, efficiently, and locking-free in nearly incompressible tests.
watch_item: The method’s practical efficiency still depends on implementing weak operators and least-squares terms accurately on general polytopal meshes.
paper_title: A Least Squares Weak Galerkin Framework for Linear Elasticity on Polytopal Meshes
